Marissa / Naomi — quick note on the hold:

- We treat non-US corporations as foreign entities; we only request W-8BEN-E when the vendor asserts foreign status to avoid 1099 reporting. If W-8BEN-E is provided and valid, no 1099 is issued.
- We need the W-8BEN-E completed and signed, and legal entity name to match the invoice to create the vendor record.
- Bank documents required to validate wiring instructions and currency conversion risks.

If KRW Labs submits the signed W-8BEN-E and corp docs by EOD tomorrow, we should be able to schedule payment on the next wire run (target date depends on currency). Note: international wires typically take 3–5 business days from approval.

I’ll hold until docs in the vendor folder. Please add any DocuSign envelope ids to the HubSpot Deal (DEAL-9987) so we can track.
